/* Ajustements visuels ChefMalin : même application, lecture plus légère. */
:root {
  --green: #315b43;
  --lime: #eff3e2;
  --cream: #fcfbf7;
  --ink: #263b2e;
  --muted: #727b72;
}

body {
  background: var(--cream);
  letter-spacing: .002em;
}

.top {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  padding: 13px 5%;
  background: rgb(252 251 247 / 94%);
  border-bottom-color: #e9e9df;
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
}

.brand {
  font-size: 28px;
  letter-spacing: -.035em;
}

.brand small {
  margin-top: 3px;
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1.35px;
}

.top nav {
  gap: 3px;
}

.top nav a {
  padding: 9px 11px;
  color: #52655a;
  font-size: 12px;
  transition: color .18s ease, background .18s ease;
}

.top nav a:hover,
.top nav a[aria-current=page] {
  background: #eef3e5;
  color: var(--green);
}

.wrap {
  max-width: 1120px;
  padding: 32px 28px 44px;
}

.eyebrow {
  color: #75805b;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
}

h1 {
  margin: 8px 0 12px;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.3vw, 40px);
  line-height: 1.08;
}

h2 {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-size: 24px;
  line-height: 1.18;
}

h3 {
  margin: 10px 0;
  font-size: 19px;
  line-height: 1.22;
}

p {
  line-height: 1.55;
}

button,
.btn {
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #315b43;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgb(36 67 45 / 12%);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 650;
  transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, background .18s ease;
}

button:hover,
.btn:hover {
  filter: none;
  background: #244a35;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgb(36 67 45 / 16%);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.secondary {
  border-color: #dbe4ce;
  background: #f3f7ed;
  color: #315b43;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.secondary:hover {
  background: #e6efd9;
}

.danger {
  background: #fff5f0;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.hero {
  height: clamp(340px, 44vw, 540px);
  background: #eee7d7;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-art {
  width: 80%;
  top: -1.2vw;
  left: 10%;
  transform-origin: 64% 50%;
  animation: pipo-float 5.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pipo-float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(.35deg); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-art { animation: none; }
}

.pipo-greeting:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2b739; outline-offset: -6px; }

.hero.pipo-says-hey .hero-art {
  animation: pipo-wave .72s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1) 3 both;
}

@keyframes pipo-wave {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
  30% { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(-.7deg); }
  60% { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(.7deg); }
}

.pipo-hello {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 3;
  top: 17%;
  right: 36%;
  padding: 10px 15px;
  border-radius: 18px 18px 4px 18px;
  background: #fffdf7;
  color: #315b43;
  box-shadow: 0 9px 22px rgb(36 67 45 / 18%);
  font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 800;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: scale(.8) translateY(8px);
}

.hero.pipo-says-hey .pipo-hello {
  animation: pipo-hello 2.6s ease both;
}

@keyframes pipo-hello {
  10%, 80% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.95) translateY(-5px); }
}

@media (min-width: 560px) and (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero .cta { top: 55%; bottom: auto; left: 22%; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero.pipo-says-hey .hero-art,
  .hero.pipo-says-hey .pipo-hello { animation: none; opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}
.hero:after {
  height: 72px;
  background: linear-gradient(transparent, var(--cream));
}

.hero .cta {
  top: 54%;
  bottom: auto;
  left: 21%;
  min-width: 264px;
  padding: 9px 24px;
  border: 3px solid rgb(252 251 247 / 92%);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #315b43;
  box-shadow: 0 9px 24px rgb(36 67 45 / 18%);
  font-size: 13px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.grid {
  gap: 17px;
}

.two {
  gap: 18px;
}

.card {
  padding: 20px;
  border-color: #e8e9df;
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(54 70 54 / 4%);
}

.green { background: #f0f4e8; }
.blue { background: #eef5f8; }
.gold { background: #fcf3e4; }

.bigicon {
  font-size: 25px;
  color: #627e49;
}

.badge {
  background: #f1f3e8;
  color: #5d6b5b;
}

.recipe-art {
  height: 76px;
  border-radius: 12px;
}

/* Les trois entrées de l'accueil restent directes et aérées. */
.home-shortcuts .card {
  --card-edge: #d9dfce;
  min-height: 205px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 7px 0 var(--card-edge), 0 16px 24px rgb(54 70 54 / 10%);
  transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
}

.home-shortcuts .green { --card-edge: #d3dfbf; }
.home-shortcuts .gold { --card-edge: #ead4ae; }
.home-shortcuts .blue { --card-edge: #c8dce8; }

.home-shortcuts .card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 11px 0 var(--card-edge), 0 20px 28px rgb(54 70 54 / 13%);
}

.home-shortcuts .card:active {
  transform: translateY(4px);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--card-edge), 0 7px 12px rgb(54 70 54 / 10%);
}

.home-shortcuts .card h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #244b37;
  font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI Rounded", sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(21px, 2vw, 26px);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -.035em;
  line-height: 1.05;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.shortcut-illustration {
  width: 118px;
  height: 118px;
  object-fit: contain;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 7px 6px rgb(32 65 46 / 15%));
  transition: transform .22s ease;
}

.home-shortcuts .card:hover .shortcut-illustration {
  transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(-2deg) scale(1.04);
}

.shortcut-moustache { width: 126px; }

.toolbar {
  gap: 9px;
  margin: 16px 0;
}

.toolbar input,
input,
select,
textarea {
  border-color: #dfe4d9;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #fffefa;
}

.calendar {
  gap: 10px;
}

.day {
  padding: 13px;
  border-color: #e7e9df;
  border-radius: 14px;
}

.day h3 {
  font-size: 17px;
}

.meal {
  padding: 9px 0;
}

.notice {
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #f7f3e6;
}

footer {
  padding: 28px;
  background: #fbfaf5;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .top {
    padding: 11px 16px 9px;
  }

  .brand {
    font-size: 24px;
  }

  .top nav {
    margin-top: 9px;
  }

  .top nav a {
    padding: 8px 8px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .wrap {
    padding: 25px 17px 34px;
  }

  .hero {
    height: clamp(280px, 56.25vw, 406px);
  }

  .hero-art {
    width: 84%;
    top: 0;
    left: 8%;
  }

  .pipo-greeting:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2b739; outline-offset: -6px; }

.hero.pipo-says-hey .hero-art {
  animation: pipo-wave .72s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1) 3 both;
}

@keyframes pipo-wave {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
  30% { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(-.7deg); }
  60% { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(.7deg); }
}

.pipo-hello {

  border-radius: 18px 18px 4px 18px;
  background: #fffdf7;

  font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 800;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: scale(.8) translateY(8px);
}

.hero.pipo-says-hey .pipo-hello {
  animation: pipo-hello 2.6s ease both;
}

@keyframes pipo-hello {
  10%, 80% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.95) translateY(-5px); }
}

@media (min-width: 560px) and (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero .cta { top: 55%; bottom: auto; left: 22%; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero.pipo-says-hey .hero-art,
  .hero.pipo-says-hey .pipo-hello { animation: none; opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}
.hero:after {
    height: 82px;
  }

  .hero .cta {
    bottom: 12px;
    left: 50%;
    min-width: 242px;
    padding: 8px 20px;
    border-width: 3px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 12px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
  }

  .hero .cta:hover {
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-1px);
  }

  h1 { font-size: 29px; }
  h2 { font-size: 22px; }
  h3 { font-size: 18px; }
  .card { padding: 18px; }
  .home-shortcuts .card h3 { font-size: 22px; }
}


/* Accueil : Pipo parle sans déplacer la bannière. */
.hero { height: clamp(400px, 52vw, 650px); }
.hero-art {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center bottom;
  animation: none;
}
.hero.pipo-says-hey .hero-art { animation: none !important; }
.hero .cta {
  top: 54%;
  bottom: auto;
  left: 21%;
  min-width: 304px;
  padding: 14px 28px;
  font-size: 17px;
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
}
.pipo-hello {
  top: 15%;
  right: 40%;
  padding: 17px 24px;
  font-size: clamp(27px, 3.4vw, 47px);
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.week-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
.mini-moustache {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 20px;
  height: 9px;
}
.mini-moustache::before,
.mini-moustache::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 1px;
  width: 13px;
  height: 7px;
  background: #315b43;
  border-radius: 85% 15% 85% 15%;
}
.mini-moustache::before { left: 0; transform: rotate(18deg); }
.mini-moustache::after { right: 0; transform: scaleX(-1) rotate(18deg); }
@media (min-width: 560px) and (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero { height: 430px; }
  .hero .cta { top: 55%; bottom: auto; left: 22%; min-width: 280px; padding: 13px 23px; font-size: 16px; }
  .pipo-hello { top: 14%; right: 35%; }
}
@media (max-width: 559px) {
  .hero .cta { min-width: 272px; padding: 12px 22px; font-size: 15px; }
  .pipo-hello { right: 22%; font-size: 28px; }
}
/* Cadrage final : contenu complet, sans recadrer le visage de Pipo. */
.hero {
  height: clamp(360px, 38vw, 560px);
  background: #f5efe0;
}
.hero-art {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain !important;
  object-position: center bottom !important;
}

}

  font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
}
.hero .cta:hover {
  background: #315b43;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #c98d12, 0 10px 18px rgb(36 67 45 / 20%);
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(3px);
}
@media (min-width: 560px) and (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero { height: 350px; }
  .hero .cta {
    top: 55%;
    bottom: auto;
    left: 25%;
    min-width: 320px;
    padding: 15px 25px;
    font-size: 18px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 559px) {
  .hero { height: 300px; }
  .hero .cta {
    top: auto;
    bottom: 16px;
    left: 50%;
    min-width: 300px;
    padding: 13px 22px;
    font-size: 17px;
  }
}
/* Bouton placé près de Pipo, sans le recouvrir. */
.hero .cta {
  left: 36%;
  min-width: 326px;
  padding: 14px 26px;
  font-size: 18px;
}
@media (min-width: 560px) and (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero .cta { left: 34%; min-width: 300px; padding: 13px 22px; font-size: 17px; }
}
@media (max-width: 559px) {
  .hero .cta { left: 50%; min-width: 280px; padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 16px; }
}
/* Profil Pipo et accès au questionnaire. */
.hero .cta { top: 52.8%; }
.profile-chip {
  position: relative;
  flex: 0 0 58px;
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  color: #315b43;
  font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.profile-chip:hover { text-decoration: none; color: #244a35; }
.profile-chip img {
  width: 43px;
  height: 43px;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: 50% 15%;
  border: 2px solid #f2b739;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fffdf7;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgb(36 67 45 / 16%);
}
.profile-chip .dot {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  right: 4px;
}
@media (min-width: 560px) and (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero .cta { top: 53.8%; }
}
@media (max-width: 559px) {
  .profile-chip { flex-basis: 46px; font-size: 10px; }
  .profile-chip img { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
}/* Les trois choix reprennent les illustrations et le relief de l’accueil. */
.cuisine-choices { align-items: stretch; }
.choice-card { position: relative; min-height: 286px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0; overflow: hidden; padding: 18px 22px 23px; border-radius: 24px; text-decoration: none; isolation: isolate; transition: transform .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease; }
.choice-card:hover { text-decoration: none; transform: translateY(-4px); }
.choice-card:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #f2b739; outline-offset: 4px; }
.choice-card.choice-green { background: #eff5e9; border-color: #dfe9d5; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #c7d8bd, 0 16px 27px rgb(45 85 61 / 14%); }
.choice-card.choice-blue { background: #eaf4fa; border-color: #d6e7f0; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #bdd7e6, 0 16px 27px rgb(45 85 61 / 14%); }
.choice-card.choice-gold { background: #fff2dc; border-color: #f1dfbf; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #ead2a6, 0 16px 27px rgb(45 85 61 / 14%); }
.choice-card:hover.choice-green { box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #c7d8bd, 0 11px 20px rgb(45 85 61 / 16%); }
.choice-card:hover.choice-blue { box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #bdd7e6, 0 11px 20px rgb(45 85 61 / 16%); }
.choice-card:hover.choice-gold { box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #ead2a6, 0 11px 20px rgb(45 85 61 / 16%); }
.choice-number { position: absolute; top: 17px; left: 19px; z-index: 2; display: grid; width: 31px; height: 31px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; color: #315b43; background: rgb(255 253 247 / 80%); font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; }
.choice-art { width: 100%; height: 132px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin: 0 0 1px; }
.choice-illustration { width: 124px; height: 124px; object-fit: contain; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 6px rgb(32 65 46 / 16%)); transition: transform .22s ease; }
.choice-card:hover .choice-illustration { transform: translateY(-5px) rotate(-2deg) scale(1.04); }
.choice-copy { display: block; padding-right: 18px; }
.choice-card h3 { margin: 1px 0 7px; color: #244a35; font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: clamp(18px, 1.7vw, 22px); line-height: 1.1; }
.choice-card p { margin: 0; color: #45604c; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; }
.choice-arrow { position: absolute; right: 18px; bottom: 17px; display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; color: #fffdf7; background: #315b43; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #244a35; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 900; transition: transform .22s ease; }
.choice-card:hover .choice-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .choice-card { min-height: 246px; } .choice-art { height: 108px; } .choice-illustration { width: 104px; height: 104px; } }/* Calendrier : une date ronde ouvre un seul menu à la fois. */
.calendar-intro { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 22px; }
.calendar-intro h1 { margin-bottom: 5px; }
.calendar-intro p { margin: 0; }
.calendar-navigation { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid #dfe7d8; border-radius: 18px; background: #fffdf7; color: #315b43; white-space: nowrap; }
.calendar-navigation strong { min-width: 142px; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; }
.calendar-nav-button { width: 37px; height: 37px; min-width: 37px; padding: 0; border-radius: 13px; background: #edf4e8; color: #315b43; font-size: 18px; }
.calendar-action-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin: 21px 0 12px; }
.calendar-action-row button { border-radius: 15px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgb(36 74 53 / 18%); }
.calendar-tip { margin: 0 0 19px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #e4e7db; border-radius: 15px; background: #f7f5ec; color: #5d6b61; font-size: 14px; }
.calendar-tip strong { color: #315b43; }
.playful-calendar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 0 0 23px; }
.calendar-date-button { position: relative; display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 9px 4px 10px; border: 1px solid #e0e7db; border-radius: 22px; background: #fffdf8; color: #315b43; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #e0e7db; transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease; }
.calendar-date-button:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 7px 0 #d2e1c9; filter: none; }
.calendar-date-button.is-selected { border-color: #315b43; background: #eff5e9; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #315b43; }
.calendar-date-button.is-today .calendar-orb { border-color: #f2b739; }
.calendar-orb { position: relative; display: flex; width: 68px; height: 68px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 3px solid #dce9d2; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fffef9, #e8f1df); color: #315b43; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 #fff, 0 5px 9px rgb(42 79 56 / 12%); }
.calendar-date-button.is-selected .calendar-orb { border-color: #f2b739; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fff7d7, #f2df9c); }
.calendar-orb small { margin-bottom: 1px; text-transform: capitalize; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; }
.calendar-orb strong { font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 27px; line-height: .9; }
.calendar-date-label { font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; }
.calendar-date-status { overflow: hidden; width: 100%; padding: 0 4px; color: #778477; font-size: 10px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.calendar-date-button.has-menu::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 11px; right: 16px; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 2px solid #fffdf7; border-radius: 50%; background: #d8a725; }
.calendar-editor { padding: 21px; border: 1px solid #dce8d4; border-radius: 24px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5faef, #fffdf7); box-shadow: 0 9px 25px rgb(45 85 61 / 10%); }
.calendar-editor-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.calendar-editor-kicker { color: #819264; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.calendar-editor h2 { margin: 3px 0 2px; font-size: 27px; }
.calendar-editor-head p { margin: 0; color: #68756b; font-size: 14px; }
.calendar-total { display: flex; min-width: 106px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 10px; border-radius: 16px; background: #315b43; color: #fffdf7; }
.calendar-total strong { font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 25px; line-height: 1; }
.calendar-total span { margin-top: 3px; font-size: 11px; }
.calendar-meals { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.calendar-meal { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #e0e8da; border-radius: 17px; background: #fffef9; }
.calendar-meal.is-filled { border-color: #cddfc2; background: #fbfff7; }
.calendar-meal-heading { display: flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.calendar-meal-heading > span { color: #315b43; font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; }
.calendar-meal-heading a { overflow: hidden; max-width: 67%; color: #315b43; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; text-overflow: ellipsis; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.calendar-meal-heading small { color: #8a9689; font-size: 12px; }
.calendar-select { display: block; margin-top: 8px; }
.calendar-select > span { display: block; margin: 0 0 5px; color: #7a887b; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.calendar-select select { width: 100%; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid #d5e1d0; border-radius: 12px; background: #f9fcf5; color: #315b43; font-size: 13px; }
.calendar-meal-bottom { display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 9px; margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 9px; border-top: 1px dashed #d7e1d4; }
.calendar-meal-bottom label { width: 72px; color: #708072; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; }
.calendar-meal-bottom input { width: 100%; margin-top: 3px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid #d5e1d0; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; font-size: 12px; }
.calendar-meal-bottom small { flex: 1; color: #68756b; font-size: 11px; }
.calendar-remove { padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff0e9; color: #a44d38; font-size: 11px; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .calendar-intro { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; } .playful-calendar { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .calendar-editor { padding: 16px; } .calendar-meals { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
@media (max-width: 430px) { .calendar-navigation { width: 100%; } .calendar-navigation strong { flex: 1; } .calendar-action-row button { width: 100%; } .playful-calendar { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 9px; } .calendar-orb { width: 61px; height: 61px; } .calendar-editor-head { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; } .calendar-total { align-self: stretch; flex-direction: row; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; } .calendar-total span { margin: 0; } }/* Liste de courses : une seule lecture, puis une sortie papier ou téléphone. */
.shopping-intro { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 22px; }
.shopping-intro h1 { margin-bottom: 5px; }
.shopping-intro p { margin: 0; }
.shopping-progress { display: flex; min-width: 116px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 13px 16px; border: 1px solid #d6e4cd; border-radius: 19px; background: #eff5e9; color: #315b43; }
.shopping-progress strong { font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; }
.shopping-progress span { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; }
.shopping-add-card { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 15px; margin: 22px 0; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #dce8d4; border-radius: 20px; background: #f5faef; }
.shopping-add-form { flex: 1; }
.shopping-add-form > label { display: block; margin: 0 0 7px; color: #315b43; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
.shopping-add-form > div { display: flex; gap: 9px; }
.shopping-add-form input[type=text],.shopping-add-form input:not([type]) { width: 100%; }
.shopping-add-form input { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid #cdddc4; border-radius: 13px; background: #fffef9; }
.shopping-add-form button { min-width: 105px; border-radius: 13px; }
.shopping-calendar-link { min-height: 46px; border-radius: 13px; white-space: nowrap; }
.shopping-list-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dce8d4; border-radius: 23px; background: #fffdf8; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgb(45 85 61 / 8%); }
.shopping-list-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3ebe0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eff5e9, #fffdf8); }
.shopping-list-head span { color: #819264; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.shopping-list-head h2 { margin: 3px 0 0; color: #315b43; font-size: 25px; }
.shopping-list-head small { padding: 7px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: #315b43; color: #fffdf7; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; }
.shopping-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.shopping-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 66px; padding: 10px 17px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ea; }
.shopping-item:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.shopping-item.is-done { background: #fbfcf9; }
.shopping-check { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
.shopping-check input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; }
.shopping-tick { display: grid; width: 29px; height: 29px; flex: 0 0 29px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #b9cfac; border-radius: 10px; background: #fffef9; color: transparent; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 900; transition: all .16s ease; }
.shopping-check input:checked + .shopping-tick { border-color: #315b43; background: #315b43; color: #fff; }
.shopping-check input:focus-visible + .shopping-tick { outline: 3px solid #f2b739; outline-offset: 3px; }
.shopping-item-name { overflow: hidden; color: #315b43; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.shopping-item.is-done .shopping-item-name { color: #8b978c; text-decoration: line-through; }
.shopping-quantity { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f4ead2; color: #6b562b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; }
.shopping-delete { width: 31px; height: 31px; padding: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #8b9a8c; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; }
.shopping-delete:hover { background: #fff0e9; color: #a44d38; filter: none; }
.shopping-empty { display: flex; min-height: 174px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 13px; padding: 25px; text-align: left; }
.shopping-empty > span { display: grid; width: 48px; height: 48px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #315b43; color: #fff; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; }
.shopping-empty p { margin: 0; color: #607060; }
.shopping-empty a { color: #315b43; font-weight: 800; }
.shopping-completed { border-top: 1px solid #e3ebe0; background: #fafcf8; }
.shopping-completed summary { padding: 14px 18px; color: #6f806f; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
.shopping-completed .shopping-list { border-top: 1px solid #edf0ea; }
.shopping-export { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; margin-top: 20px; padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 21px; background: #fff3dd; }
.shopping-export h2 { margin: 0 0 3px; color: #315b43; font-size: 22px; }
.shopping-export p { margin: 0; color: #6e624d; font-size: 13px; }
.shopping-export-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 9px; }
.shopping-export-actions button { border-radius: 13px; white-space: nowrap; }
.shopping-clear { margin-top: 14px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #7b877b; font-size: 12px; }
.shopping-clear:hover { background: #fff0e9; color: #a44d38; filter: none; }
@media (max-width: 700px) { .shopping-intro { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; } .shopping-add-card { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; } .shopping-calendar-link { width: 100%; } .shopping-export { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; } .shopping-export-actions { width: 100%; } .shopping-export-actions button { flex: 1; } }
@media (max-width: 430px) { .shopping-add-form > div { flex-direction: column; } .shopping-add-form button { width: 100%; } .shopping-item { gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; } .shopping-item-name { font-size: 14px; } .shopping-quantity { padding: 5px 7px; font-size: 10px; } .shopping-delete { width: 25px; } }
@media print { body { background: #fff !important; } .top, footer, #toast, .shopping-intro, .shopping-add-card, .shopping-export, .shopping-clear, .shopping-completed, .shopping-delete { display: none !important; } .wrap { max-width: none !important; padding: 0 !important; } #shopping-print-area { border: 0 !important; border-radius: 0 !important; box-shadow: none !important; } .shopping-list-head { padding: 0 0 16px !important; background: #fff !important; } .shopping-tick { border-color: #315b43 !important; } }/* Assistant de restes : recherche locale, lisible et sans IA distante. */
.leftover-intro { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 22px; }
.leftover-intro h1 { margin-bottom: 5px; }
.leftover-intro p { margin: 0; }
.leftover-calendar-note { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid #dbe7d2; border-radius: 17px; background: #eff5e9; color: #315b43; text-decoration: none; }
.leftover-calendar-note strong { font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; }
.leftover-calendar-note span { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.2; }
.leftover-workspace { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 235px; gap: 18px; margin-top: 23px; }
.leftover-steps { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 9px; }
.leftover-steps span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f3f5ec; color: #677568; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.leftover-steps b { display: grid; width: 19px; height: 19px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #315b43; color: #fff; font-size: 11px; }
.leftover-form { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #d9e6d1; border-radius: 23px; background: linear-gradient(140deg, #f5faef, #fffdf8); }
.leftover-form > label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #315b43; font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 900; }
.leftover-input-wrap { position: relative; }
.leftover-input-wrap textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 103px; padding: 14px 14px 28px; border: 1px solid #cbdcc2; border-radius: 16px; background: #fffef9; color: #315b43; resize: vertical; }
.leftover-input-wrap small { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 9px; color: #829082; font-size: 10px; }
.leftover-shortcuts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin: 13px 0 17px; }
.leftover-shortcuts > span { margin-right: 2px; color: #708072; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; }
.leftover-shortcuts button { padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid #d6e3d0; border-radius: 999px; background: #fffef9; color: #315b43; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; }
.leftover-shortcuts button:hover { background: #e8f1df; filter: none; }
.leftover-submit { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; border: 3px solid #f2b739; border-radius: 15px; background: #315b43; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #c98d12; font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; }
.leftover-submit:hover { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #c98d12; filter: none; }
.leftover-method { align-self: stretch; padding: 19px; border-radius: 23px; background: #fff1d9; color: #5e513d; }
.leftover-method-badge { display: inline-grid; width: 43px; height: 43px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #315b43; color: #fffdf7; font-family: "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; }
.leftover-method h2 { margin: 13px 0 6px; color: #315b43; font-size: 21px; }
.leftover-method p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; }
.leftover-results { margin-top: 25px; }
.leftover-results-head { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 15px; }
.leftover-results-head > div > span { color: #829264; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.leftover-results-head h2 { margin: 4px 0 3px; color: #315b43; font-size: 28px; }
.leftover-results-head p { margin: 0; color: #6d796d; font-size: 13px; }
.leftover-token-summary { max-width: 35%; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 13px; background: #f3f5ec; color: #697869 !important; font-size: 12px !important; }
.leftover-token-summary strong { color: #315b43; }
.leftover-invention { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; margin: 0 0 13px; padding: 17px 19px; border: 1px solid #f0dcaf; border-radius: 19px; background: #fff3dd; }
.leftover-invention span { color: #ad7d24; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.leftover-invention h3 { margin: 4px 0; color: #315b43; font-size: 22px; }
.leftover-invention p { margin: 0; color: #6c624d; font-size: 13px; }
.leftover-invention button,.leftover-match button { padding: 10px 13px; border-radius: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }
.leftover-match-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 13px; }
.leftover-match { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 243px; flex-direction: column; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #dfe8da; border-radius: 20px; background: #fffef9; }
.leftover-match.is-best { border-color: #bcd6ae; background: #f4f9ef; box-shadow: 0 7px 0 #d9e8d0; }
.leftover-match-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.leftover-score { padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #edf3e8; color: #3f684b; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; }
.leftover-best-label { color: #b07c1e; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; }
.leftover-match h3 { margin: 12px 0 8px; color: #315b43; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.15; }
.leftover-match p { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #647164; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; }
.leftover-have strong { color: #315b43; }
.leftover-missing strong { color: #9b7650; }
.leftover-ready { color: #347150 !important; }
.leftover-match button { margin-top: auto; align-self: flex-start; }
.leftover-empty-result { padding: 20px; border: 1px dashed #cddbc4; border-radius: 17px; background: #f7faf4; color: #697869; }
.leftover-disclaimer { margin: 15px 0 0; color: #7a867b; font-size: 11px; }
